rule_text: Flag new dependencies, outdated packages, suspicious install scripts, missing lockfile changes, or dependency additions without review.
safe_patterns: Review package reputation, maintenance, and vulnerability history.
Require CI checks before merging dependency changes.
title: Dependency Risk: Track Third-Party Components And Known Vulnerabilities
unsafe_patterns: Adding a new dependency without explaining why it is needed
Installing packages from unknown or misspelled names
Running install scripts from untrusted packages
Using unpinned versions in production paths
